channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why are US Republicans losing faith in War Secretary Pete Hegseth?
item.description: The reasons for dissent are not unanimous, ranging from the war in Iran to an overhaul of military leadership.

item.title: UN rights chief says Iran executed at least 56 people since March
item.description: Volker Turk warns of surge in Iran executions to suppress dissent after January uprising.

item.title: Iran, Oman, US ‘close’ to Hormuz deal: What do they all want?
item.description: An agreement could restore shipping through crucial waterway, paving way for peace talks between Tehran and Washington.

item.title: Lebanon and Israel still split over disarming Hezbollah at Rome talks
item.description: Disagreements remain in second day of resumed talks over disarming Hezbollah and Israeli withdrawal from South Lebanon.

item.title: India’s severe monsoon season causes more than 100 deaths since July
item.description: Monsoon downpours cause floods and landslides as climate change and El Nino disrupt rainfall patterns.

item.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
item.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

item.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
item.description: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.

item.title: Trump says Iran will be 'hit very hard' if Hormuz Strait not open soon as oil prices fall
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent both announced talks had progressed to allow shipments to resume.

item.title: The avalanche that killed a climbing legend - and a generation of record-setting guides
item.description: Their fellow guides say their deaths in Pakistan dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community.

item.title: Mysterious elephant deaths in Kenya raise questions around pesticides
item.description: A wave of Kenyan elephant deaths has been blamed on pesticides, but experts tell the BBC they are doubtful.
